exceptions.reason: The row gives the default `'bottom'`. The part has no Vue default: a prop that is absent lets `Menu.Positioner` take `'bottom'` for a root context menu and `'inline-end'` for a submenu, as in Base UI. Only an absent `side` gives a root context menu the offsets `-5` and `2`. With a Vue default, a submenu opens below its trigger and a root context menu loses those offsets.

The part is `Separator`. The part writes `aria-orientation`, which the role `separator` takes, so CSS selects `[aria-orientation='vertical']` and the part writes no `data-orientation` (rule 8.15). The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).
